answer: Each submission hangs on the delta of a task receipt, and the karst is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission, idle agents bleed standing. By the fable of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
